title: FxPy - Custom Programming Language
shortDescription: A dynamically-typed, interpreted programming language built from scratch in Python with support for functions, control flow, modules, and more.
features: Dynamic Typing: Flexible type system with runtime type checking
First-Class Functions: Support for higher-order functions, closures, and arrow syntax
Module System: Import/export with relative path resolution and selective imports
Variadic Functions: *args and **kwargs support for flexible function signatures
Rich Error Reporting: Position-aware errors with visual indicators and stack traces
Interactive REPL: Live code execution with immediate feedback
